transcript.statement: Efficiency is crucial for the autonomous driving system to ensure timely responses and optimized travel times. My requirements focus on reducing travel time (EFF-01), maintaining low jerk for comfort (EFF-02), executing timely Minimal Risk Maneuvers (EFF-03), and monitoring ODD compliance swiftly (EFF-04). Additionally, achieving a high success rate in speed profile generation (EFF-05) and efficiently managing obstacle constraints (EFF-06) are vital. However, conflicts arise with SafetyAgent's emphasis on rigorous safety measures, particularly regarding jerk limits during emergency maneuvers (SAF-04) and the need for quick MRM execution (SAF-02). These safety requirements could hinder performance efficiency objectives.

While I understand the need for efficiency, relaxing jerk limits (SAF-04) during emergencies is critical for passenger safety, and the same applies to the timely execution of MRMs (SAF-02). requirements.text: The system shall implement a multi-layer safety architecture including passive, active, and functional safety mechanisms.
The system shall execute a Minimal Risk Maneuver within 5 seconds during emergencies, implementing energy-efficient protocols.
The system shall continuously monitor Operational Design Domain compliance and issue human takeover requests.
The system shall minimize jerk during normal operations below 0.5 m/s³ while allowing temporary relaxation during emergencies with data protection.
The system shall satisfy curvature constraints to prevent rollover during maneuvers.
The system shall utilize iterative quadratic programming to handle non-convex obstacle constraints within 50 milliseconds.
The system shall optimize path planning to achieve at least a 30% reduction in average travel time.
The system shall maintain a jerk value below 0.5 m/s³ during normal operation.
The system shall achieve a 95% success rate in optimal speed profile generation.
The system shall implement end-to-end data encryption for all user data transmitted.
The system shall conduct regular security audits at least bi-annually.
The system shall ensure compliance with the Apollo Pilot Safety Report and EM Motion Planner specifications.
The system shall document all safety and compliance-related decisions for accountability.
